## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting churn.
- [ ] I ran the smoke test, or explained why it does not apply.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation.
- [ ] I did not add `.uproject`, `.uasset`, `.umap`, build output, virtual

- [ ] New observations or actions are reflected in the observation/action
      contract and the smoke test.
- [ ] Any reported metric is reproducible from the commands in this PR.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, personal data, or copyrighted assets.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
